# Black Bear (`monsters:black-bear`)

**AC** 11 | **HP** 19 (3d8 + 6) | **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
**STR** 15 (+2) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 14 (+2) | **INT** 2 (-4) | **WIS** 12 (+1) | **CHA** 7 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +5
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15
**Languages:** None

- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
